core_obligations: Reduce by distinguished triangles, exactness of colimits and the truncation triangles to the case of a single nonzero cohomology sheaf of L (proof lines 7929-7946).
Reduce the complex case to a single coherent module using the short exact sequences from stupid truncations of I^n F^bullet (proof lines 7948-7962).
Prove injectivity of colim Ext^i_X(I^n F, G) -> Ext^i_U(F|_U, G|_U) for i > 0 by the kernel construction, the Artin-Rees pro-isomorphism and induction on i (proof lines 7974-8026).

Prove surjectivity by extending a killing surjection from U to X, applying Artin-Rees to get the containment F' cap I^m F'' inside I^n F', and using that the cokernel is supported off U (proof lines 8028-8086).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to one cohomology sheaf and one term (proof lines 7929-7962).
Reduction to the Ext statement and the case i = 0 (proof lines 7964-7972).
Injectivity via Artin-Rees and induction (proof lines 7974-8026).
Surjectivity via extension from U and Artin-Rees (proof lines 8028-8086).
difficulty_reason: For an open immersion j : U -> X of Noetherian schemes, a Deligne system (K_n) with value K in D^b_Coh(O_U) of the constant system (K_n|_U), and an object L of D^b_Coh(O_X), the lemma asserts that colim Hom_X(K_n, L) = Hom_U(K, L|_U) (statement lines 7919-7927). The proof is a sequence of reductions. First, for a distinguished triangle L -> M -> N -> L[1] one gets a map of long exact sequences because the colimits are exact by Derived Categories, Lemma labelled derived-lemma-representable-homological and Algebra, Lemma labelled algebra-lemma-directed-colimit-exact, so the statement for two of the three objects implies it for the third by the 5-lemma, and using the truncation triangles of Derived Categories, Remark labelled derived-remark-truncation-distinguished-triangle one reduces to L with a single nonzero cohomology sheaf (proof lines 7929-7946). Next, choosing a bounded complex F^bullet of coherent modules and an ideal I cutting out X minus U with K_n represented by I^n F^bullet, the termwise split short exact sequences coming from stupid truncations give compatible systems of triangles, reducing to the case where F^bullet has one nonzero term (proof lines 7948-7962). The lemma is thus reduced to the isomorphism colim Ext^i_X(I^n F, G) -> Ext^i_U(F|_U, G|_U) for coherent F and G and all i >= 0, where the case i = 0 is Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma labelled coherent-lemma-homs-over-open (proof lines 7964-7972). For injectivity, an element whose restriction to U vanishes is represented in the abelian category of coherent modules via Derived Categories of Schemes, Proposition labelled perfect-proposition-DCoh, giving a surjection F'' -> F killing it; the kernel F' then yields a commutative diagram of colimits whose rows are exact, Artin-Rees makes the inverse systems (I^n F') and (I^n F'' cap F') pro-isomorphic by Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma labelled coherent-lemma-Artin-Rees, and induction on i plus the exactness of the rows forces the class to die (proof lines 7974-8026). For surjectivity, an element over U is killed by a surjection from a coherent O_U-module, which is extended to X by Properties, Lemma labelled properties-lemma-extend-finite-presentation; the same kernel and Artin-Rees argument, together with the fact that F/I^m Im(phi) is supported on X minus U and Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma labelled coherent-lemma-power-ideal-kills-sheaf, produces an element over X mapping to the given class (proof lines 8028-8086). Running the two reductions by triangles and truncations, and then the two Artin-Rees diagram arguments, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
